# Reading, without the noise

Mivu gives your Markdown a little room to breathe. **Read carefully**, select a passage, and keep going.

## A familiar rhythm

- Open a document.
- Follow the ideas.
- Let the page stay out of your way.

> Good tools make space for the work.

| The reader       | The details                   |
| ---------------- | ----------------------------- |
| Local by default | No accounts, no tracking      |
| Read-only        | Your words stay yours         |
| Quietly current  | Refreshes when a file changes |

- [x] Make space for reading
- [ ] Read the next chapter

~~An editor~~ A reader.
